newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADC reiterated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADC reiterated as buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it was reiterating its buy rating for ADC Telecommunications Inc.

-- "We believe that ADC continues to experience extremely robust demand across a broad range of businesses in broadband connectivity, transmission and data networking," analyst Tim Luke wrote in a report.

-- "Following conversations with management, we consider that the company remains on track to secure several significant hybrid fiber coax (HFC) contracts over the next several weeks and that ADC may be able to formally announce at least one of these contracts within the next 10-15 days."

-- "... Our 12-month price target of $40 is based on our view that ADC's rapid revenue and earnings growth should enable the shares to achieve a multiple of at least 35x our initial calendar 1998 estimate of $1.18."
-- The company's stock fell on Wednesday after ADC told analysts it may announce details of only one of four new cable telephony contracts by the end of the year.
